pit_plan.status: fictional compact source-scene concept; not an Assetto Corsa ready pit; not FIA compliant or safety assessed
pit_plan.coordinates: metres; local X east, Y north, Z up; EPSG:32637 minus origin
pit_plan.direction: A-E-B-C-D-A; pit traversal follows main track southwest
pit_plan.source: OSM geometry from v04 surroundings_local.json; © OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL 1.0
pit_plan.placement: Sector D, 85–150 m before D; exit at4340m precedes mapped bridge start4343.308m. Five shelters; row starts5m upstream.
pit_plan.reason: v07 map audit found the prior exit extended into the mapped bridge approach. Only the fictional pit geometry is corrected; the main road remains fixed.
pit_plan.capacity: 5 perpendicular small garages, 4.5 by7.5m; working space and driving need game validation
pit_plan.vertical_design: One continuous graded garage/apron floor; terrain cut updated locally. Garage floor follows the longitudinal row grade rather than independent level overlapping slabs.
assumptions_and_limits: OSM gaps are not proof of truly empty land. Fences, trees, driveways, gardens and unrecorded buildings need photos.
Widths, pavement and garages are fictional game-track design, not existing physical features.
Stream only has a mapped centerline: actual banks/floodplain are unverified. There is no new stream crossing in this concept.
This short pit needs very low speed and early deceleration on the main road; the sampled curve radius is geometry only, not a handling test.
Main road surface intersection is intentional only at entry and exit tapers. Apron and bays do not overlap the main road.
Do not remove mapped houses or streets to fit this concept. Reconsider after photo evidence and in-game driving tests.
